scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.build:packages: bun run --filter @crafter-station/badge-studio-design build && bun run --filter @crafter-station/badge-studio-renderer build && bun run --filter badgio build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && bun run --cwd packages/cli typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/cli build && bun test packages apps/web/src/lib apps/web/src/app/design
